title: Aftermath
subtitle: Post-apocalyptic storybook adventure where brave rodent critters build and defend their colony
tagline: Humans are gone. Now it's our turn.
loreSummary: In the mysterious absence of humanity, small critters must rise up to survive amidst overgrown concrete ruins. Playing as a brave band of rodents, you must venture out into a perilous suburban wasteland to scavenge food and scrap, combat hostile predators, and build a lasting sanctuary for your colony.
keyFeatures: Innovative Adventure Book system turning every turn into an evolving illustrated encounter
Dynamic colony management requiring strategic resource foraging, building upgrades, and crisis management
Card-driven tactical gameplay with personalized critter decks and cooperative action sharing
Rich narrative campaign featuring 27 missions filled with branching choices and personal character stories

aftermath_colony_campaign.name: Colony Survival Campaign
aftermath_colony_campaign.description: The recommended 20-mission campaign experiencing the primary narrative arc and key colony milestones.

aftermath_core_story.name: Core Story Arc
aftermath_core_story.description: Streamlined 12-mission playthrough focusing purely on the central mystery of the humans' disappearance.

aftermath_full_chronicle.description: Exhaustive 27-mission journey unlocking every side quest, personal critter objective, and colony upgrade.
